subject: Aldous Plumbing home page, phone layout (fictional calibration, shaped after a real 15 October 2026 review)

notes.observation: The owner is introduced too far down the page.
notes.raisedBy: Eunice Ordor (stakeholder), agreed by the independent audit
notes.problem: A homeowner letting a stranger into the house cannot tell who is coming until well down the page.

evidence.note: the first person is met in the fifth section

evidence.ref: Eunice Ordor, client relations review of the phone layout, 15 October 2026
independent audit of the phone layout, reported not re-measured

notes.impact: A homeowner with a stopped boiler cannot see who is coming into the house, so they may ring someone else or ask before reaching the introduction.

suggested.change: move the full biography directly below the hero

recommend.change: show the owner's name and one line about working alone beside the first call button
recommend.because: The visitor's worry is who is coming into the house, so a name and one line answer it where the call is first offered.
recommend.whyEnough: The full biography already serves visitors who want it further down, so only a name and a line need to meet the homeowner early.

requires.what: the owner's name and that he works alone and answers the phone

notes.observation: Third-party credibility appears just below the first phone screen.
notes.problem: A homeowner worried about being overcharged by someone they have never met meets the independent reviews only after the first screen.

evidence.ref: independent audit of the phone layout, reported not re-measured

notes.impact: A homeowner worried about being overcharged by a stranger has only the van and one photograph to go on until they scroll to the customer reviews.

recommend.change: bring one verified customer line and its source into the first screen
recommend.because: A homeowner worried about being overcharged by a stranger is answered by someone who trusted him in their house.
recommend.whyEnough: One line with its source is enough to meet the worry on the first screen, and the full customer quotes can stay where they are.
recommend.validation: Look at the first screen at 375 wide and check the line and its source are readable without scrolling, then ask three recent customers what they looked for first.

requires.what: a customer review that can be checked

notes.observation: The hero image could be a slideshow.
notes.problem: The visitor wants to see more of the work before deciding.

evidence.ref: Eunice Ordor, client relations review of the phone layout, 15 October 2026

existing: swipeable gallery of finished jobs directly after the services

suggested.change: turn the hero image into a slideshow

recommend.because: The page already lets the visitor swipe through finished jobs, so a second carousel adds a script and shows the same work again.

notes.observation: Some project captions could be removed.

evidence.ref: Eunice Ordor, client relations review of the phone layout, 15 October 2026

evidence.note: one short line each, saying what was fixed

evidence.ref: independent audit of the phone layout, reported not re-measured
evidence.note: found the captions concise and useful for navigation

recommend.because: Each caption is one short line saying what was fixed, so removing them takes useful detail from a visitor judging the work.

notes.observation: The owner and reviews could come before the services list.

evidence.ref: Eunice Ordor, client relations review of the phone layout, 15 October 2026

suggested.change: move the services list below the reviews

recommend.because: A visitor with a failed boiler first needs to see this plumber does that work, so the services list is rightly early.

notes.observation: The page could communicate more personality.
notes.problem: The page does not yet sound like the man who answers the phone.

evidence.ref: Eunice Ordor, client relations review of the phone layout, 15 October 2026

notes.impact: A homeowner letting a stranger into the house learns little about the plumber's own way of working from the generic introduction.

suggested.change: add a hover animation to the service cards

recommend.change: write the introduction in the owner's own account of how he works
recommend.because: Personality that comes from the plumber's own words tells a homeowner who is coming, which an animation cannot.
recommend.whyEnough: The owner's own account replaces the generic lines, and no new component, script or image is needed for it.
recommend.validation: Read the introduction aloud to the owner and check it sounds like him, then ask three customers whether it matches the man who came.

requires.what: the owner's own account of how he works, in his words

notes.observation: The owner appears too late on the page.
notes.impact: A homeowner with a stopped boiler cannot see who is coming into the house until well down the page.

recommend.change: show the owner's name beside the first call button
recommend.because: The visitor's worry is who is coming into the house, so a name answers it where the call is first offered.
recommend.whyEnough: A name beside the call is enough on the phone, and the desktop layout has not been looked at.
